ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (29) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form).

In Kant's passage «рассудок» (rassudok) is 'understanding' and «разум» (razum) 'reason', as in Kant's own pairing, and «ученый» (uchyony) is 'learned'. «Фома Кемпийский» (Foma Kempiysky) is Thomas à Kempis, and «Индийское Гитопадее» (Indiyskoye Gitopadeye) is given as 'Indian Hitopadesha', as elsewhere in the book.

Source observation: [21] «Индийское Гитопадее» (Gitopadeye): the title of the Hitopadesha is misspelled (elsewhere in the book «Гитопадезе»); a letter seems to have dropped out. Translated as 'Indian Hitopadesha'.
